dtoPolicy.note: Local v1 types and routes only; no official provider response source claimed. Minimal documented identity is required for every entity, plus fqdn for Site (baseline doubles lines 370-416). All other typed fields absent from baseline doubles are optional under addendum 6, validated and mapped if present. Unknown properties are discarded, including passwords. No DTO strict objects. Deletes discard the deserialized JSON value and acknowledge input identifiers.
dtoPolicy.pagination: No baseline pagination inputs or documented numeric list limits for these nine lists; no invented query parameters, limits, or truncation.
dtoPolicy.emptyBody: The existing gateway requires deserializable JSON. Empty 2xx handling is owned by FEAT-10; this fixture models baseline envelopes with null data.
